newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH AUG GDP DATA SUPPORTS GOVT VIEW -NIINISTO.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH AUG GDP DATA SUPPORTS GOVT VIEW -NIINISTO.

text.p: Finland's 2.1 percent year-on-year growth in gross domestic product (GDP) in August was in line with the government's forecast of 2.8 percent growth for this year, Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto said on Thursday.
"In my view, it supports the government's view of where GDP growth this year will be moving," Niinisto told a seminar.
August economic growth slowed from a 3.9 percent increase in July, Statistics Finland said earlier.
